subject: Software Engineering
moduleTitle: Unit 1 — Introduction to Computer Organization, Architecture & Top-Level Structure
moduleDescription: The fundamental dichotomy between computer architecture and organization, the multi-tier hardware/software abstraction hierarchy, the Von Neumann stored-program model, top-level components (CPU, Memory, I/O, System Bus), the four basic computer functions, and CPU internal microarchitecture (ALU, Control Unit, and Register Transfer Language).
